description: A script for uploading diffs from version control systems (Git, Mercurial, Subversion) to a code review application, handling authentication, diff generation, and file uploads.

classes.name: ClientLoginError
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during client login authentication.

classes.name: AbstractRpcServer
classes.description: Base class providing interface for RPC server communication.

classes.name: HttpRpcServer
classes.description: Implementation of RPC server communication over HTTP with cookie support.

classes.name: VersionControlSystem
classes.description: Abstract base class for interacting with version control systems.

classes.name: SubversionVCS
classes.description: Implementation of VCS interface for Subversion.

classes.name: GitVCS
classes.description: Implementation of VCS interface for Git.

classes.name: MercurialVCS
classes.description: Implementation of VCS interface for Mercurial.

methods.name: GetEmail
methods.description: Prompts user for email, remembers last used email.

methods.name: StatusUpdate
methods.description: Prints status messages based on verbosity level.

methods.name: ErrorExit
methods.description: Prints error message and exits program.

methods.name: EncodeMultipartFormData
methods.description: Encodes form data and files for multipart/form-data POST.

methods.name: GetContentType
methods.description: Guesses MIME type based on filename.

methods.name: RunShellWithReturnCode
methods.description: Executes shell command, returns output and return code.

methods.name: RunShell
methods.description: Executes shell command, exits on error.

methods.name: GuessVCS
methods.description: Guesses version control system in current directory.

methods.name: RealMain
methods.description: Main logic for uploading diffs and interacting with server.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point executing RealMain with exception handling.
